title: Supporter Role
description: Receive the Supporter Role for approximately 1 month.
bullets: Receive the Supporter Role for approximately 1 month.
Includes 1 month of access to all Donator Perks.

title: Exclusive Content
description: Access to our exclusive supporter-only content channel.
bullets: Access to our exclusive supporter-only content channel.
Get access to content shared specifically for supporters.

title: Translation Requests
description: Request a translation for any show of your choice ($8.99+ contribution).
bullets: Donators who contribute $8.99 or more can request a translation for any show of their choice.
Translation requests are limited to up to 26 episodes per request.
Please keep in mind that larger requests take time, so this limit helps prevent the workload from becoming unmanageable.

title: Supporter Discussions
description: Access to the Supporter-only discussion channel.
bullets: Access to the Supporter-only discussion channel.
A place for supporters to discuss shows, translations, upcoming projects, and more.
